topic: Which dreamy food escape would you choose?

files.name: 01.png
files.label: THE HONEY PALACE
files.must_show: A large honey-drizzled layered cake with pistachios and flower petals is the dominant prepared food in the foreground.
files.observed_subject: A tall honey-glazed layered cake with visible cream layers, pistachios and flower petals stands on a copper pedestal in a tiled courtyard.

files.name: 02.png
files.label: THE CHOCOLATE TERRACE
files.must_show: A large layered chocolate cake topped with raspberries is the dominant prepared food in the foreground.
files.observed_subject: A tall layered chocolate cake with dripping ganache, raspberries and chocolate shavings stands on a bronze cake stand on a sunset terrace.

files.name: 03.png
files.label: THE LAVENDER BREAKFAST
files.must_show: A plated croissant with berries is the dominant prepared food in a lavender-field breakfast setting.
files.observed_subject: A large flaky croissant with berries sits on a plate beside yogurt, coffee and juice on a lavender-field terrace.

files.name: 04.png
files.label: THE SUNRISE MEZZE
files.must_show: A large pan of shakshuka with eggs is the dominant prepared food on a breakfast table.
files.observed_subject: A pan of egg shakshuka with bread, cheeses, olives and tea is displayed on a breakfast table overlooking rock formations and hot-air balloons.

files.name: 05.png
files.label: THE DESERT TEA FEAST
files.must_show: A brass tray of dates, baklava and fruit is the dominant prepared food at a desert camp.
files.observed_subject: A brass serving tray holds dates, baklava, figs and grapes beside tea glasses and a brass pot at a desert camp.
